software.title: Wikiman
software.subtitle: Personal wiki and mobile admin app
software.description: A personal wiki. The Vue frontend and Node/PHP backends share one API contract, and the Android/iOS admin app can quickly post text, photos, and files.

software.title: PHAST API
software.subtitle: Lightweight PHP REST framework with attributes
software.description: A lightweight framework for building REST APIs quickly on PHP hosting. Endpoints are declared with PHP 8 attributes.
contributions: Used by the Wikiman PHP backend

software.title: Game Sync
software.subtitle: Game-save sync for multiple PCs
software.description: Manages different save paths per PC by account and game, zips directories, and stores them on a server. Restore from upload history or request an upload on another PC for the same account.

hardware.title: M-Tracker
hardware.subtitle: Vehicle telematics and cloud upload device
hardware.description: Automotive hardware that decodes CAN signals and sends trip logs, speed, and location to a cloud server.

hardware.title: Dooderge Connector — Kiruki
hardware.subtitle: Industrial multi-interface data collector
hardware.description: An industrial connector that collects RS-232, RS-485, Wi-Fi, LAN, and contact signals and sends them to a server.

hardware.title: BMW Bike Cluster
hardware.subtitle: Android cluster for BMW Motorrad
hardware.description: An integrated project that decodes BMW motorcycle LIN or CAN signals and shows speed, RPM, gear, and controls on an Android cluster.

hardware.title: Uljin Skyrail data collector
hardware.subtitle: LTE vehicle-status collection and monitoring
hardware.description: Collects status data from Skyrail vehicles, sends it to a server over LTE, and shows operations on a monitoring web UI.
